title: Test Engineering
description: JSON Schema for test engineering artifacts, focusing on measures of performance for systems against defined subjects.

measureOfPerformance.description: Represents how a specific system performs against a set of subjects (metrics).

id.description: Unique identifier for this measure of performance entry.

name.description: Optional short label or title for this measure of performance.

description.description: Human-readable description of the measurement context and methodology.

system.description: Reference to the component (system, hardware, or software) whose performance is being measured.

subjectValues.description: List pairing subjects to observed values for this system.

subjectId.description: Reference to a subject UUID representing the measurable attribute.

value.description: Observed value(s) for the subject, optionally with unit.

measuresOfPerformance.description: A collection of measures of performance.
